actions.reason: C0001 has a coherent, biologically interpretable identity supported by FDR-significant RNA (21/50 Hallmark pathways, moderate-to-large SMDs, organized around lower heme metabolism and higher EMT) and FDR-significant CNV (CDKN2A loss, chr9p/9q loss), with a nominal PBRM1 enrichment in WXS. The membership is structurally compatible with this identity, no set-specific technical association reaches significance for C0001, and stage/grade overlap is very low. Structural metrics are weak but do not positively support a Split or Merge, and no available evidence request can resolve a decision-critical uncertainty. Retaining C0001 for downstream validation is therefore better supported than Drop.

C0002 has a coherent molecular identity supported by a strong FDR-significant CNV signal (18/49 continuous features, including lower chr12p/VHL/chr20q and reduced chr14q/chr8p loss), an FDR-significant WXS PBRM1 enrichment, and a moderate RNA signal with consistent direction (higher pancreas-beta-cell, lower IL6/JAK/STAT3). Membership is structurally compatible, no set-specific technical association reaches significance, and stage/grade overlap is very low. Structural metrics are weak but do not positively support Split or Merge, and no listed evidence request can resolve a decision-critical gap. Accept is better supported than Drop.

C0003 has a coherent identity defined primarily by a strong, FDR-significant WXS signal (VHL and PBRM1 depletion, q=0.0011 and q=0.00047) with a correspondingly strong WXS fixed-membership silhouette (0.581) and larger WXS boundary separations. RNA and CNV are weak, but a single strong modality can define a defensible discovery-stage candidate when the signal is coherent and not contradicted. No set-specific technical association reaches significance for C0003, stage/grade overlap is very low, and the structural evidence does not positively support Split or Merge. Accept is better supported than Drop.

C0004 has a coherent identity supported by FDR-significant WXS findings (BAP1 enrichment and PBRM1 depletion) together with a positive WXS silhouette and the highest internal resampling stability among the sets (ARI 0.790, PAC 0.315). Although C0004 shows set-specific technical associations (tissue source site, CT manufacturer, reconstruction kernel), these are measured alternative explanations rather than demonstrated artifacts, and the defining evidence is molecular (WXS) rather than CT-driven, so they do not dominate the identity. Stage/grade overlap is very low, and no structural evidence positively supports Split or Merge. Retaining C0004 for downstream validation is better supported than Drop.
